payload.title: Anth.us content: convert 69 plain-string citation authors to CSL author lists (post-cutover)
payload.description: After cutover (Gatsby retired, content main free to change). 69 bibliography entries in AnthusAI/anthus-site-content store author/editor as a single string (e.g. 'Garrett Hardin', 'Sam McVeety and Amir Hormati', comma-joined runs like 'Ilia Shumailov, Zakhar Shumaylov, ...', 'Dan Milmo and agency'). Papyrus #91 renders them as literal names (no APA inversion/initials). Convert each to a proper CSL list ([{family, given}] for people, {literal} for organisations), fixing oddities like 'and agency', 'et al', 'Ph.D.', so the bibliographies are consistently APA-formatted. A codemod plus a human review of the ambiguous ones; re-run the 25-page citation comparison afterwards.
